clue.text: Particular variety of sheep's head and guts

indicators.note: the head of the word sheep's is its opening letter

parts.note: tripe is the stomach lining of a cow or sheep, eaten as offal

explanation.surface: A butcher's talk of one breed of sheep and its offal.
explanation.definitionFit: A stripe can mean a kind or sort, as in people of every political stripe.

clue.text: Artisan nobbled crooner

indicators.note: nobbled means tampered with, so the letters of artisan are disturbed

explanation.surface: A craftsman got at a singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank Sinatra was the famous American crooner.

clue.text: Nick turned to automaton

parts.note: to nick is to steal or rob

indicators.note: turned means the little word to is flipped round

explanation.surface: Someone called Nick became a machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A robot is a mechanical automaton.

clue.text: Bird, 51, cracked nut

indicators.note: cracked means the nut is broken open to take something inside

parts.note: a pecan is a nut
LI is 51 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A bird aged 51 breaks open a nut.
explanation.definitionFit: The pelican is a large water bird with a throat pouch.

clue.text: What shouldn't happen on a peninsula?

parts.note: a crime is an act that ought not to take place

explanation.surface: A riddle about what is forbidden on a stretch of coastline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' simply sets the A after the crime in this across answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Crimea is the peninsula jutting into the Black Sea.

clue.text: Lifted supermarket right off

indicators.note: lifted in a down clue means the letters read upward, so backwards

parts.note: Netto is a discount supermarket chain

explanation.surface: Someone shoplifted from a supermarket's right-hand shelves.
explanation.walkthrough: Netto is a Danish discount supermarket chain once common in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Food that has gone off has spoiled, decayed and become rotten.

clue.text: Help for addict swamping party in gas

indicators.note: swamping means the gas engulfs the party

parts.note: methane is a gas
a do is a party

explanation.surface: An addict's drug overwhelms the party, like a gas.
explanation.definitionFit: Methadone is a synthetic opioid prescribed to wean heroin users off the drug.

clue.text: Look into oxtail soup, fishing out one amphibian

indicators.note: into means the look goes inside the jumbled letters
soup suggests a mixture, so the letters are stirred around
fishing out means a letter is pulled from the word oxtail

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
lo is an old word meaning look

explanation.surface: A cook peers into oxtail soup and fishes out an amphibian.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters come from OXTAL, the soup ingredient with one letter fished out; the look sits inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: The axolotl is a Mexican salamander that keeps its larval gills into adulthood.

clue.text: "Things beyond our ken … ": poem lesbian doctor's rewritten

indicators.note: rewritten means the letters are written out again in a new order

parts.note: DR is the abbreviation for doctor

explanation.surface: A poem about mysteries, revised by a lesbian doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: Imponderables are matters that cannot be measured or fully understood.

clue.text: Little cakes turned over — or up?

definitions.note: elliptical for turned up, as a nose may be

indicators.note: turned over means the word for the cakes is flipped end to end

parts.note: buns are small round cakes

explanation.surface: A puzzled cook wonders whether the cakes were flipped or flipped upright.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition borrows 'turned' from earlier: '(turned) up?' describes a nose.
explanation.definitionFit: A snub nose is short and tilted upward, so snub describes a turned-up nose.

clue.text: Imposing boundaries on Mantel's last copy

indicators.note: last picks the final letter of the novelist Mantel's surname

parts.note: an imitation is a copy

explanation.surface: A literary critic notes how a copy of Hilary Mantel's latest novel sets limits.
explanation.definitionFit: A limitation is the act of restricting something, putting bounds on it.

clue.text: Interference with musical holding it back

indicators.note: back means the whole combination is then read in reverse
holding means the show's name wraps around the word it

parts.note: Cats is the Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: A theatre complains of disruption during a musical that keeps it in its repertoire.
explanation.walkthrough: The insertion goes right after the opening letter, giving CITATS before the turnaround.
explanation.definitionFit: Static is crackle on a radio or phone line, a form of signal interference.

clue.text: Surgeon, one formerly employed in telephone exchange

definitions.meaning: a surgeon is one who operates

definitions.text: one formerly employed in telephone exchange
definitions.meaning: switchboard staff who connected calls by hand

explanation.surface: A career change from medicine to an old-fashioned switchboard job.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a surgeon working in theatre and a switchboard worker connecting calls carry this job title.

clue.text: Fuss after swindle involving return of supporter's diamond

indicators.note: after places the fuss at the end
involving means the swindle wraps round the next piece

parts.note: a con is a swindle

indicators.note: return of means the support garment is read backwards

parts.note: a bra is a supporting garment
ado is fuss

explanation.surface: A fuss over a fraud concerning a backer's diamond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporter' is not a fan but an undergarment, the bra.
explanation.definitionFit: Carbonado is an opaque black form of the gemstone, used industrially.

clue.text: Second endlessly supporting bass solo about weight problems

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue means sitting below the other pieces

parts.note: an aria is an operatic solo

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a trice is an instant, a second

explanation.surface: A singer cuts short a second bass solo about obesity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second endlessly' is TRICE losing its E; 'supporting' sets it beneath B + ARIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Bariatric medicine concerns obesity and its treatment, such as gastric surgery.

clue.text: Part of India's left end

parts.note: Goa is a state on India's west coast

explanation.surface: A geography note on the extreme western tip of India.
explanation.definitionFit: A goal is an aim or objective, the end one works toward.

clue.text: Split up role

definitions.meaning: to separate or go different ways
an actor's character in a play

explanation.surface: Dividing out the roles of a play.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to separate, as couples do; the noun is a character an actor plays.

clue.text: Falsely claim to nurse in advance?

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before, in advance
to tend is to nurse

explanation.surface: Someone falsely claims to have looked after a patient beforehand.
explanation.definitionFit: To pretend is to make a false show or profession of something.

clue.text: Shout about barren waste yielding fruit

indicators.note: about means the shout surrounds the next letters

parts.note: to cry is to shout

indicators.note: waste means the letters of barren are laid waste and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone shouts that a barren wasteland has produced fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'waste' looks like a noun in the scene, but it shuffles the barren letters to ANBERR.
explanation.definitionFit: The cranberry is a small, tart red berry grown in bogs.

clue.text: Close bond with something to sleep in

parts.note: nigh means near, close
a tie is a bond

explanation.surface: A close bond with one's bedclothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightie is a nightdress, a garment worn in bed.

clue.text: Die, held up by mythical bird or stag

indicators.note: held by means the bird encloses the next piece
held by means the bird encloses the next piece

parts.note: rok is a variant spelling of roc, the giant bird of Arabian legend

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the letters read upward, so backwards

parts.note: a die is a cube

explanation.surface: A giant legendary bird or a deer meets its end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Die' is not to perish but a gambling cube, read upward as EBUC; the bird is in its rarer spelling, a variant of roc.
explanation.definitionFit: A roebuck is the male roe deer, a stag of that species.

clue.text: Can Oriental money reduce restraint?

parts.note: can and loo are both slang for a toilet
the sen is a small coin of Japan and other Asian countries

explanation.surface: A question whether Eastern cash can ease controls.
explanation.definitionFit: To loosen a grip or a rule is to slacken it, making it less tight.

clue.text: Tom-tom heading off to Belgium for sacrifice

indicators.note: to means the next piece is added on

parts.note: a tom is a he-cat, a male cat

indicators.note: heading off means the word tom loses its first letter

parts.note: B is the international vehicle code for Belgium

explanation.surface: A drum is carried to Belgium for a ritual offering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom-tom' looks like the drum but is two toms: HE-CAT, then TOM minus its head, OM.
explanation.definitionFit: A hecatomb was an ancient Greek sacrifice of a hundred oxen, hence a great slaughter.

clue.text: Good antique, antiquely precious

parts.note: olden means of old, antique

explanation.surface: An auction appraisal of a valuable old piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'antiquely' marks a dated, poetic sense of precious, as in golden opportunity or golden days.
explanation.definitionFit: In older and literary use the word describes something of great value or excellence.

clue.text: Contract bridge opponents carrying field

indicators.note: carrying in a down clue means the lower piece bears the upper one

parts.note: a lea is a meadow or field
South and East sit as opponents at the bridge table

explanation.surface: A contract bridge game with opponents across a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contract bridge' looks like one phrase, but the definition stops at 'Contract'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lease is a contract letting property for a set term.

clue.text: Backward glance sees traditional religious order originally held in esteem

parts.note: respect is esteem

indicators.note: originally picks the opening letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: A historian looks back at a traditional religious order once highly regarded.
explanation.definitionFit: Retrospect is a review of past events, looking back over them.

clue.text: Backing instrument's border

indicators.note: backing means the brass instrument is written backwards

parts.note: a tuba is a brass instrument

explanation.surface: A musician talks of the edge of an accompanying instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: To abut is to adjoin, to share a border with something.

clue.text: Redistribute booze to soprano dropped from higher accompaniment

indicators.note: dropped from means the soprano letter is taken out of the melody

parts.note: a descant is a counter-melody sung above the main tune

explanation.surface: A choir passes round drinks when the soprano leaves the descant.
explanation.definitionFit: To decant wine is to pour it from its bottle into another vessel.

clue.text: Decorate journalist receiving summons? On the contrary

indicators.note: receiving signals one piece taken inside another
on the contrary says it is the summons that takes in the journalist, not the reverse

parts.note: a beck is a beckoning gesture, a summons
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: An instruction to dress up a reporter who has been served a summons.
explanation.definitionFit: To bedeck is to adorn or festoon with ornaments.
